contentSummary: This is a bare-bones client testimonials page carrying four short verbatim quotes from maritime organisations that have audited or visited the Alang yard — NYK Ship Management, ClassNK, JNA Japan, and an individual, Keiji Tomoda. The quotes praise yard infrastructure, the team's appetite for learning, safety and environment-friendly operation, and specifically call out the floating platform as a good idea; two of them explicitly frame it as ongoing improvement ("Hope to see next upgrading"). Everything else on the page is chrome: a 400px empty image banner, a two-item "Our Companies" sidebar list, a contact-details sidebar widget, and a full-width ISO certification strip. The entire…
